messages:
olivia (People Ops): Quick update: we've published a short policy addendum covering export-control responsibilities for teams working with international partners + a harmonized global benefits enrollment window for supplemental benefits. Two required items this cycle: 1) complete the Export Controls micro-module (7-9 min); 2) confirm your team's benefits enrollment status in the Enrollment Tracker. Deadline for managers: 2026-05-20. Link: https://go.redwood/hr/export-benefits-2026

sam (People Ops): TL;DR: employees in roles touching data export, model distribution, or cross-border deployments must finish the export module. Everyone should check benefits eligibility and opt-in/decline by May 20. We'll push reminders twice weekly.

hani (Legal): Legal note: the addendum clarifies export control obligations (classification, red flags for customer requests, and escalation paths). If your work involves partner deployments outside NA/EU, you likely need the module. Exceptions for interns under 30 days recorded in the tracker.

leah (Benefits): For global benefits harmonization: this is an opt-in enrollment window for supplemental healthcare stipends and commuter top-ups. Eligibility varies by country; we pre-filled eligibility in the tracker for each person. If the prefill is wrong, managers: update the "eligibility correction" column and CC benefits@redwood.com.

kevin (EM): Quick Q 14 does the export module apply to contractors on infra teams? We have two contractors managing cross-region syncs.

olivia (People Ops): If contractors touch customer data or ship models across borders, yes. If not, mark them as exempt in the "exemptions" tab and ping me.

anita (Hiring Ops): Ops note: new hires who accepted after 2026-04-01 get auto-enrolled in the benefits prefill and must do the module during onboarding step 2. Please include the module link in your offer packs if you manage international hires.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-05T14:00Z  autopulse for teams with >30% unstarted completions.

sam (People Ops): Manager checklist: 1) Review the Enrollment Tracker export (we'll drop per-manager CSVs); 2) Confirm export module completions in the tracker by May 20; 3) Fix eligibility prefill errors or escalate to Benefits; 4) Add short note for any exemptions.

kevin (EM): Can you drop a per-manager CSV? My team list is slightly different from org export.

leah (Benefits): Yes, I'll upload per-manager CSVs into /PeopleOpsExports/1775001234_enrollment_csvs.zip by EOD today. If you want a contractor-only slice, DM me.

hani (Legal): Also please attach a one-line audit note in the tracker when making any manual eligibility change so we have a trail for compliance.

olivia (People Ops): Copyable blurb for teams: `Heads-up: Policy addendum on export controls + global supplemental benefits enrollment window. Complete the Export Controls micro-module (7-9m) and confirm your team's benefits status by May 20. Managers  confirm in the Enrollment Tracker. Questions? ping people-ops or benefits.`

kevin (EM): Perfect  will post in my squad channel.

anita (Hiring Ops): One more ops note: offers with cross-border deployment responsibilities will get an automated flag so Hiring Ops can confirm module included in onboarding tasks.

sam (People Ops): Action recap: managers = confirm modules and enrollment in tracker by 2026-05-20; Benefits will post CSVs and handle corrections; Legal will audit changes. We'll post this in #announcements after 1pm PT. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
